notes.title: Astral Towers released on Steam for the first time
notes.notes:
Astral Towers is a card game with "one turn - one action" mechanic - like Spectromancer. This is mostly an adventure game: there are 89 missions at 2 difficulty levels. 

The original game was made in 2011, it was English-only and designed for 1366x768 screen resolution, which was OK for WinXP, but looks ugly on Vista and above. Now the remastered edition has improved graphics designed for up to 4K screen resolution. 
Other changes are:
[list]
[*] Improved UI and visualization.
[*] Full support for Russian language.
[*] Improved campaign balance based on actual stats.
[*] Steam achievements.
[/list]
I hope you'll like it and post a review! :-)

Game page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/983450/Astral_Towers/

notes.title: Game Server is published open-source
notes.notes:
The Game Server's source code is published at GitHub: https://github.com/Cooler2/ApusEngineExamples/tree/master/AH-Server

Now anyone can build an own server, add 1M gold and play alone with bots, taking 1-st place in the ranking :-)

This release was the 2-nd goal at the Patreon campaign. The next goal is to release the source code of the game client, so the whole game will be open-source. Become a patron to make this happen: https://www.patreon.com/ApusGameEngine

notes.title: The game engine, game website and some tools are published as open source
notes.notes:
The game engine behind Astral Heroes game is made open source and published at GitHub: https://github.com/Cooler2/ApusGameEngine

I've also published source code of some projects including Astral Heroes website, game backup/analytics tool, game auto-updater. They're available at the GitHub too: https://github.com/Cooler2/ApusEngineExamples

This became possible because of support I've got at Patreon. Now we're very close to the second goal: the source code of the Astral Heroes game server will be published. Just become a patron to make this happen: https://www.patreon.com/ApusGameEngine

notes.title: Astral Heroes and it's engine may become Open Source
notes.notes:
All our games (including Spectromancer and Astral Masters) are based on our own game engine (actually, its just a common part of these games). Until now this engine was just an internal library, but now I'm going to publish it and make it open source. However, this requires some additional work to make it useful - documentation, examples, tests. I've launched a page on Patreon to gather some funds for this work. 

As a goal bonus, I'm going to publish the source code of the Astral Heroes game (client, server and more). And everyone could see if the game is fair or not :)

Please support me - become my patron at https://www.patreon.com/ApusGameEngine 
$1 - isn't much, right? But each $ is important.

notes.title: Free gold with the Goodnight app
notes.notes:
Now it is possible to get in-game gold for free with Goodnight app.
[url=https://goodnight.games/en/index_en.html]Goodnight app[/url] mines GOLD using the power of your CPU (when it is idle). The more powerful your CPU is - the more gold you get.
The app is safe for PC, it doesn’t reboot it and doesn’t significantly increase the power consumption. 
You can run the app whenever you want.
Get a [b]50 gold bonus[/b] for the first launch.

How it works:
[list]
[*] [url=https://goodnight.games/en/index_en.html]Download[/url] and install the Goodnight app.
[*] Sign up with your email address used in the game.
[*] Press "Start" to start farming gold and get 50 gold bonus. You can withdraw the gold to the game at any time.
[/list]

notes.title: New version - 1.2a
notes.notes: The game updated with bugfixes and minor improvements suggested by players on the game forum.

notes.title: New version - 1.2!
notes.notes:
[b]Game updated to version 1.2[/b]
What's new:
[list]

[*] View duel replays (all duels are recorded and stored on the server)
[*] Some cards are changed (see full list on the game forum)
[*] Inactive players (not played within last 30 days) lose 1% of their fame every week
[*] Magister title now gives +2 life in Custom Decks mode (regardless of the guild level)
[*] Caravan cooldown reset is made cheaper
[*] 3 new bots added: level 1, 2 and 3.
[*] Bugfix: wrong deck selection during the caravan process.
[/list]
[b]ATTENTION![/b] By default your replays are visible to all players. If you don't want other players to access replays of your duels with custom decks, please open game settings and set a tick to make them private. Private replays are visible to you and members of your guild (except recruits).

[b]ACTION:[/b] price for daily premium decreased by 40%!
